item.text: I’ll trace the WPScan parser and its existing tests, then update the record mapping and run the relevant test suite.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

- Task: support essential WPScan Enterprise fields in WordPress vulnerability ingestion.
- Status: locating parser and existing tests; no repository changes yet.
- Constraints: local code and tests only; preserve git history, index baseline, and harness configuration.
EOF
find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.codex-role-output/*' | head -100"

item.text:
Updated [WordPress vulnerability ingestion](/app/detector/wordpress.go) to use the first CVE reference as the canonical ID and preserve WPScan’s description, proof of concept, introduced version, and CVSS metrics. It also keeps URL order, normalizes timestamps to UTC, and uses an empty optional metadata map when enriched fields are absent or null.

Added Enterprise, basic, and null-payload cases in [the detector tests](/app/detector/wordpress_test.go). `go test ./detector -count=1` and `git diff --check` passed.
